image_description: A collection of adhesive bandages (Band-Aids) and related first-aid items arranged on a white background. The image features several standard beige fabric bandages, red plastic or fabric bandages, a large novelty bandage with reversed text reading 'BANDAGE' and 'First Aid', a small circular antiseptic patch, and a tube of ointment. The objects appear to be floating or loosely arranged without clear physical contact shadows.
